correctness.rationale: For degrees 1–5 the exact nonzero modular minors show full column rank. For degree six the 12×12 minor has determinant 61 mod101 and an explicit nonzero icosahedrally invariant sextic is annihilated by all tangential gradients. That proves exact nullity one over the complex numbers. The companion checker independently rebuilds all matrices and checks every determinant and invariant tangential gradient.

value.rationale: An exact first-in-degree failure on the natural 30-point icosidodecahedral orbit explains why an overdetermined gradient-only sampler cannot recover a unique sextic. The six-degree complete rank profile distinguishes the unique symmetry-forced invisible mode from other possible failures, and provides a precise derivative-sampling benchmark beyond an elementary existence observation.
